findings.claim: Canonical --dart-only generation can recursively delete a directory outside the repository through a symlinked canonical output root.
findings.evidence: assertSafeOutput trusts output === canonicalOutput, while removeGeneratedDirectory validates only the final target and can miss a symlinked canonical ancestor.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate the canonical output and every existing ancestor with lstat/realpath immediately before deletion and require the resolved target to remain inside the resolved repository directory.

findings.claim: The canonical --dart-only path re-signs potentially stale Rust documentation into a fresh combined native API manifest.
findings.evidence: Dart-only deletes and regenerates only Dart, skips Rust, then unconditionally calls writeNativeApiManifest for canonical output.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject partial canonical generation or prevent it from writing the combined manifest.
